evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible rules about creating games; other stories build on game existence.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids URL-based access/invitation; estimator joining via URL is consistent.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story constrains item entry to a different mechanism; importing/copy-paste are additional ways to add items, not incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with participant/estimator visibility of item lists; no story prohibits showing the list.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with re-estimation and browsing prior rounds; no conflicting rule about item selection.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story disallows adding items; import/copy-paste are alternative/additional methods.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story states items are immutable; editing is consistent with managing the item list.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires items to be retained; deletion is consistent with list management.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with the rule that estimates are shown only after all estimators have estimated to ensure independence.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids using an average; manual entry/auto-fill are compatible alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict manual entry or average acceptance; it is a conditional convenience behavior.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry is compatible with other acceptance mechanisms (average/auto-fill).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with selecting items for re-estimation and viewing prior rounds; no story forbids re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with copy/paste and manual entry; no story mandates only one ingestion method.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with import and manual entry; no conflicting constraint.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits browsing; deletion of games is a separate action and not inherently inconsistent.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with exporting transcripts; deletion removes stored data but does not contradict viewing when data exists.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing transcripts and exporting as CSV; multiple export formats are not conflicting.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with viewing transcripts and exporting as HTML; no incompatibility.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with browsing/viewing/exporting; those can apply to non-deleted games and deletion can remove availability afterward.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with login, change details, delete account, and password reminder; no contradictory account model stated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with account creation and password reminder; no story specifies a different authentication method that excludes this.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids changing details; consistent with account lifecycle stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires indefinite retention of account/games; deletion is compatible with other features when account exists.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a fixed timezone display; no inconsistency found.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with account creation/login; no story forbids email use for account recovery.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story fixes the card set to a single sequence; ordering consistency can still hold within the chosen set.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies a different maximum team size; consistent with inviting/joining behavior.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator inviting via URL; no story requires estimators to have accounts instead.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts item visibility to moderators; consistent with estimation participation.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator seeing all items; no story prohibits estimators from seeing the list.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Does not require revealing estimate values; compatible with showing all estimates only after everyone has estimated.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with the moderator ability to show all estimates immediately before all estimators have estimated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with changing estimate until draw completion; aligns with draw completion concept.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates ... so that I can see how his or her opinion has changed
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with storing results in a non-identifiable way; showing per-estimator history requires identifiable linkage of estimates to a person across time.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with storing results in a non-identifiable way if transcripts/results are intended for research storage without identification; this requires identifiable association of estimates to individuals.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids participant-started timers; consistent with timer reset behavior.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with having a shared timer; no conflicting reset rule elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with transcripts and re-estimation; no story prohibits viewing prior round information.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with choosing between two card sets; ordering can remain consistent within the selected set.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with PP-034; both allow changes until completion/showing.

evaluations.evidence: thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids showing participant identity cues during the game; potential privacy tension is only a conflict if it contradicts explicit non-identifiable storage requirements (which concern stored results).

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires non-compliance or incompatible technical constraints.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts having shared definitions.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible database constraints.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies an incompatible browser support policy.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts accessibility compliance.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires slow responses or incompatible performance constraints.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts character sets to ASCII or similar; compatible with other features.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible URL behavior.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story contradicts providing error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with stories requiring per-estimator identifiable estimate histories and attribution of estimates to specific people.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be aggregated and do not inherently contradict non-identifiable storage; no explicit incompatible constraint stated.
